Beginning of Wave 16 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mystery''' is a fast enemy that spawns another enemy upon its death. The enemy spawned depends on mode and wave, making the '''Mystery''' a potentially very dangerous enemy, especially if the player is unlucky and comes unprepared. This appears primarily appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes, and in some [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode exclusive modes, these being [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] mode, [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. They also appeared in [[The Heights]] during the [[SFOTH Event]]. The '''Mystery''' can be spawned by the [[Void Reaper]]. ==Logbook Description== "''The Mystery is still a mystery. It seems they have not decided upon what they wanted to become and instead choose to wander the Void. They like to watch from a distance, studying everyone from a distance. It’s not sure what it wants to become but perhaps they are window-shopping for a new identity. They have been seen trying to lure others into the darkness and if that happens, only one of them returns.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Mystery''' is an entity made out of stone with a question mark on their torso. It has three walking animations it can choose from. |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The legacy '''Mystery''' is a translucent glass green humanoid with a glowing orange question mark on its torso. It is faceless and small green question marks are emitted from its torso when it is killed. |Enemies Beta |The [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Mystery''' had a pastel light green skin color, with its torso and legs being a darker shade of green with a plaid stitch mark pattern on them. It also had a desaturated yellowish-orange question mark on its chest. |Version 3 |The third version of the legacy '''Mystery''' is similar to the current version, except it had a drooling zombie face and did not emit green question marks upon death. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Mystery''' is similar to the third version, except it was more translucent, and its skin color was a lighter shade of green. Its question mark did not glow either and had a vibrant orange color. |Version 1 |The first version of the legacy '''Mystery''' is similar to the second version, except it was blue. }} }} ==Enemy Spawned== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Mystery''' summons in one enemy on death.
